verdict.rationale: Docs confirm card creation, cardholder creation, and replacement of lost/stolen/damaged/expired cards, which covers part of the lifecycle story, but there is no explicit evidence of activate/pause/unpause status toggles, a permanent-close action, or documentation that a replacement card is explicitly linked to the original. missing for 10: explicit pause/unpause API status, permanent card closure endpoint, and documented linkage between original and reissued card.
